ideas.name: Agentic NOC Incident Commander
ideas.problem: Engineers lose time correlating alarms, KPIs, topology and customer tickets.
ideas.five_hour_demo: Inject a base-station incident; the agent gathers evidence, finds a root cause, simulates a fix, requests approval and opens a ticket.
ideas.extension: Connect Prometheus/Grafana, NetBox, ServiceNow or a real operator OSS.

ideas.name: Customer Impact & Outage Communication Agent
ideas.problem: Network teams see alarms, while customers experience an unexplained loss of service.
ideas.five_hour_demo: Map a simulated outage to affected subscribers, prioritize vulnerable users and create personalized Kazakh/Russian status messages.
ideas.extension: Add CRM, geospatial coverage, contact-center and notification integrations.

ideas.name: Enterprise SLA Assurance Agent
ideas.problem: B2B customers need proactive protection of latency, availability and throughput SLAs.
ideas.five_hour_demo: Monitor synthetic KPIs, predict an SLA breach, explain the cause and recommend traffic rerouting with human approval.
ideas.extension: Integrate streaming telemetry, contracts and SD-WAN/network controllers.

ideas.name: SIM-Swap and Subscription Fraud Response Agent
ideas.problem: Fraud signals are fragmented across device, account, location and transaction systems.
ideas.five_hour_demo: Score a suspicious SIM replacement, gather supporting signals, explain the risk and require approval before blocking the account.
ideas.extension: Add graph analytics, streaming events, KYC and bank/fintech signals.

ideas.name: Field Technician Dispatch Copilot
ideas.problem: Repair teams receive incomplete tickets and inefficient routes.
ideas.five_hour_demo: Turn an alarm into a repair plan, select a technician by skills and distance, prepare a checklist and update the work order.
ideas.extension: Connect inventory, maps, workforce management and computer-vision inspection.

ideas.name: Event-Aware Network Capacity Agent
ideas.problem: Concerts, matches and emergencies create local traffic spikes that static planning misses.
ideas.five_hour_demo: Load an event schedule and traffic history, forecast congestion and propose temporary capacity or load-balancing actions.
ideas.extension: Add mobility data, weather, city events and live RAN telemetry.

ideas.name: RAN Energy Optimization Agent
ideas.problem: Radio sites consume energy even when local traffic is low.
ideas.five_hour_demo: Forecast hourly load, recommend safe sleep-mode windows and show energy savings without violating coverage constraints.
ideas.extension: Use real RAN counters, electricity tariffs, weather and carbon-intensity data.

ideas.name: Rural Coverage Planning Digital Twin
ideas.problem: Remote communities need better coverage under strict infrastructure budgets.
ideas.five_hour_demo: Compare candidate tower locations using synthetic terrain, population and cost data, then explain the best investment.
ideas.extension: Add OpenStreetMap, elevation, drive-test and regulator coverage data.

ideas.name: Explainable Tariff and Retention Agent
ideas.problem: Subscribers often overpay, run out of data or churn because plans do not match real usage.
ideas.five_hour_demo: Analyze a synthetic usage history, recommend a plan, explain savings and execute a plan change only after confirmation.
ideas.extension: Add billing, campaign systems, consent management and experimentation.

ideas.name: Open Gateway API Composition Agent
ideas.problem: Developers struggle to discover and combine telecom capabilities such as number verification and device location.
ideas.five_hour_demo: Describe an application in plain language; the agent selects mock CAMARA APIs, builds a workflow and tests it in a sandbox.
ideas.extension: Connect GSMA Open Gateway/CAMARA APIs and publish reusable workflows.
